people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
translations.bsb: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
translations.kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
translations.asv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one go to them from the dead, they will repent.
